learningObjectives: Apply method overriding and polymorphism in Java.
Use abstract classes and interfaces to define reusable contracts.

activities.title: Inheritance Map
activities.instruction: Connect parent classes with their child classes.

content.concept: Inheritance allows a class to reuse and extend fields and methods from another class.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Override Anatomy
activities.instruction: Identify the parts of a method override.

content.concept: Method overriding lets a subclass provide its own implementation of an inherited method.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Polymorphism Matcher
activities.instruction: Match each reference with its runtime behavior.

content.concept: Polymorphism allows a parent type reference to work with objects of compatible child types.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Abstraction Builder
activities.instruction: Build an interface or abstract class from the requirements.

content.concept: Abstraction exposes essential behavior while hiding implementation details.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.
